title: AI and Blackness: Towards moving beyond bias and representation
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper did not measure anything related to faith or religion. The focus was on antiblackness and racial bias in a semantic network.
findings: Not applicable. The paper's findings are related to racial bias and antiblackness, not religion.
